data.description:
## Description

**What**: Refactor Debug-everything Phase F (tier 0-1 auto-fix) and Phase G (tier 2-7 fix-batch) to create fix/* and bug-batch/* PRs with base=session_branch, consuming the shared SESSION_BRANCH resolution helper.

**Why**: Debug-everything currently uses local /dso:review for sub-branch review, diverging from sprint's CI-driven flow. Converging both skills onto per-branch-review.yml makes CI review semantics consistent and enables the same provenance verification on debug sessions.

**Scope**:
- IN: Update debug-everything SKILL.md Phase F and Phase G to open fix/* and bug-batch/* PRs with base=session_branch; consume resolve-session-branch.sh for SESSION_BRANCH resolution; remove local /dso:review dispatch for ci-pr sub-branches (route to per-branch-review.yml instead); local debug mode byte-identical to pre-epic baseline
- OUT: Updating sprint Phase F (S2); SESSION_BRANCH helper creation (S-NEW); provenance verifier (S5); GitHub Ruleset setup (S3)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, debug-everything Phase F creates fix/* PRs with base=session_branch (not main) when dso.workflow=ci-pr
  ← Satisfies: "sprint Phase F + debug Phase F/G in ci-pr mode both invoke per-branch-review.yml" (SC5)
- When this story is complete, debug-everything Phase G creates bug-batch/* PRs with base=session_branch when dso.workflow=ci-pr
  ← Satisfies: SC5 skill convergence
- When this story is complete, debug-everything SKILL.md references no local /dso:review calls for ci-pr sub-branches
  ← Satisfies: SC5 "no local /dso:review in ci-pr branches"
- When this story is complete, local debug mode (dso.workflow=local) is byte-identical to pre-epic baseline (verified via git diff against pre-epic commit-breadcrumbs.log)
  ← Satisfies: SC5 local mode preservation
- When this story is complete, SESSION_BRANCH is resolved via resolve-session-branch.sh; fail-fast on resolution failure
  ← Satisfies: Operational Constraint (SESSION_BRANCH resolution)
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] SESSION_BRANCH resolution must use the same resolve-session-branch.sh helper as S2 to prevent drift between sprint and debug session resolution logic.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a debug operator in ci-pr mode, debug sub-branches open PRs against the session branch instead of main
